comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: The package registry
themes.text: You can sign in to the registry with a passkey and manage your packages in the browser. Owners can publish security advisories, and `nvs pkg audit` reports them.

themes.title: Regular expressions, services and the debugger
themes.text: A `[regex]` setting in `nvs.toml` can stop slow patterns from compiling. A service can listen on a port below 1024 through socket activation. The debugger shows your tasks as a tree.

themes.title: Spreadsheets and PDF
themes.text: `Novis\Spreadsheet` computes formulas, writes `.ods` files and reads every part of every format it opens. The spreadsheet and PDF extensions check more of their input, and PDF tables lay out like a browser draws them.
